_note: CONFLICT triggers: requests that contradict an explicit authority constraint. signals are matched (case-insensitive substring) against the problem statement; detect=color_literal means the kernel regexes for raw colour literals instead.

prohibitions.statement: Non-zero border-radius anywhere — zero radius is a system policy (enforced globally).
Removing focus outlines without an equivalent visible :focus-visible replacement.
Raw colour literals where tokens exist; off-palette colours must be added to the token source deliberately, not inlined.
Off-system font stacks (Geist / Geist Mono or inherit only).
Redefining a system custom property (--bg, --acc, --surface-*, …) in product CSS.
A confirm() dialog or custom modal to delete a listed entity — entity deletes use the armed two-step pattern instead.
Page-local toast markup or query-param toasts — the shared toast host owns feedback.
Chart colours chosen ad hoc instead of the dataviz palette (CVD-checked, greyscale-safe).
